summary: Fix the Phase 1 browser fixture so a staged management-network CIDR refusal is returned on POST and projected as an alert. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Test-only fixture; operator workflows and guide copy are unchanged.

api.reason: No Controller or Core contract changed; the browser route now returns the existing Core refusal text on POST.

state.reason: No durable state is added or changed.

verification.method: Inspected the failing controller-browser job: Stage with 192.0.2.999/24 left the form filled and found no role=alert because the route fulfilled POST like a successful GET. Confirmed host-network.tsx leaves CIDR validation to Core and surfaces submitError from a non-OK POST. Updated the fixture to return 400 with Core's CIDR sentence on POST.
